episode.program_solution:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (starts (filter (lambda (r)
                           (or (= r 0)
                               (not (equal? (nth g r) (nth g (- r 1))))))
                         (range 0 h)))
         (n (length starts))
         (heights (map (lambda (j)
                         (- (if (< (+ j 1) n) (nth starts (+ j 1)) h)
                            (nth starts j)))
                       (range 0 n)))
         (chosen (let walk ((j 0) (answer '()))
                   (if (>= j n) answer
                       (walk (+ j (nth heights j) 1) (cons j answer))))))
    (cellmap g (r c v)
      (let ((j (- (length (filter (lambda (s) (<= s r)) starts)) 1)))
        (if (and (!= v 0) (member j chosen)) 2 v))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (let* ((gi (reduce (lambda (acc r2)
                                         (if (all? (lambda (kc)
                                                     (= (at g r2 kc) (at g (- r2 1) kc)))
                                                   (range 0 w))
                                             acc
                                             (+ acc 1)))
                                       0
                                       (range 1 (+ r 1)))))
                      (if (and (zero? (mod gi 3)) (!= v 0)) 2 v))))))
